History

A name rooted in the village.

In the 19th century, tanners working along the Chiers river used to wipe their greasy hands on the backs of their leather trousers.

That nickname given to the villagers became a tribute: Les Gras Q, a restaurant attached to its place and to the people who shaped it.

19th c.The tanners leave their mark on the popular history of Cons-la-Grandville.
TodayChristelle and Gérald welcome guests around traditional cuisine.
SeasonThe menu changes regularly with the produce and the mood of the moment.
